title: TransportConfig / AuthProvider separation enables free composition — must not be merged
description: TransportConfig (TLS, trust roots, connect timeout) and AuthProvider (per-request credentials) are separate traits. A contributor might suggest merging them for simplicity. The separation exists because these are orthogonal concerns with different lifecycles: TransportConfig is used once at construction to build reqwest::Client; AuthProvider is called on every request. Merging would prevent the legitimate combination of CustomCaTransport with BearerAuth or NoneAuth. The current design documents this explicitly in the module-level doc and the trait docs.
